prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1136; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and is entitled to full and fair consideration of the resulting claim. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We also request that you disclose the full liability and bodily injury limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any dash camera or telematics information. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing.
